challenge.method: Compared the tag target with the detail URL, then checked the ID, name, deprecation flag, supersession comment and both reference fields against OSI record 466.
challenge.results: The “superseded” comment coexists with isDeprecatedLicenseId=false. Both crossRef and seeAlso name the OSI 1.0 route, and the publisher body excludes the neighboring 1.1 edition.

limitations: The mapping attributes an identifier to SPDX. It establishes neither equality of legal texts nor compatibility, succession, work-specific rights or historical approval.
